entities.summary: Neama Said Fahmi Said is an Egyptian weightlifter. She won the gold medal in the women's 64 kg event at the 2021 World Weightlifting Championships held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. She represented Egypt at the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris, France.
